description: This file defines a React component 'TabbedUserModal' along with internal subcomponents 'UserDetailsView' and 'UserProjectsView'. It provides a modal interface for viewing user details and associated projects, utilizing hooks and external UI components. It includes styling and accessibility features.

methods.name: UserDetailsView
methods.description: A React functional component that displays user details in a styled grid layout.

methods.name: UserProjectsView
methods.description: A React functional component that fetches and displays a list of projects associated with a user.

methods.name: TabbedUserModal
methods.description: Main React component that renders a modal with tabs for user details and projects, managing state and tab switching.
